verdict_reason: FTW ships no country-wide boundary product for Malaysia (only Kenya/Vietnam/Laos/Colombia underway per ecosystem.html); the 24-country benchmark also excludes Malaysia. No public TSPKS/MPOB holding-area geometry or access route was found on MPOB's site, so FTW-vs-TSPKS has no confirmed reference set. WebSearch quota was pre-exhausted, so TSPKS status is unresolved, not disproven.
